module.title: Days 1–10 | Foundation Module
module.description: First ten complete lessons; prepared for admin review before production publishing.

lessons.title: Challenge orientation & strategy
lessons.objective: Understand the challenge format, scoring mindset, time management and preparation strategy.
lessons.core_teaching_content: This challenge lesson develops challenge orientation & strategy for GK Challenge. Begin with a short strategy briefing, then use progressively harder questions. Learners should justify methods, manage time and review errors.
examples: Warm-up: one accessible question to activate the relevant concept.
Challenge example: tutor models a multi-step solution and identifies distractors.
Transfer challenge: learner solves a novel problem under a short time limit.
lessons.practical_activity: Challenge ladder: warm-up → standard → advanced → one stretch question.
lessons.guided_practice: Solve two questions with the tutor, requiring the learner to state the strategy before answering.
lessons.independent_practice: Complete a timed set and classify each question as Easy / Medium / Hard after attempting it.
questions: What clue helped you choose the strategy?
Which distractor or trap could mislead a learner?
Can you solve the problem using another valid method?
How would you improve your time without sacrificing accuracy?
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: 10-question timed checkpoint; target 70%+ accuracy and a written explanation for all errors.
lessons.student_task: Prepare a personal challenge card with one solved example, one unsolved question and your strategy.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Encourage reasoning, pacing and verification; never reward guessing over justified answers.
lessons.reflection_completion: Write the strategy that worked best today and the one habit you will change in the next challenge.
